purpose: Choose exactly one value from a visible set of mutually exclusive options.
useWhen: Users must compare a small set of visible options and select one.
The selected value belongs to a RadioGroup.

avoidWhen.situation: Each choice can be selected independently.
The option list should be collapsed or searchable.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use select for a collapsed list or combobox for filtering.

supportedInteractions: Keyboard group navigation and selection through React Aria
approvedPatterns: Always place related Radio items inside RadioGroup.
Give RadioGroup a visible label or accessible name.
Use description for supporting option detail and errorMessage with an invalid option when needed.
limitations: Radio is not intended as a standalone independent toggle.
Control and indicator internals are private.
style overrides are not supported and className is intended for outer layout.
accessibility: Uses React Aria RadioGroup and Radio semantics.
Group-level keyboard behavior, disabled state, and controlled selection are provided by React Aria.
Description and invalid error content use React Aria text slots.
responsive: RadioGroup is vertical by default but root className can define responsive grid or flex layout.
rtl: Controls, labels, and group layout follow inherited document direction.
